rules.message: Commit pubspec.lock (this is an application package: publish_to: none)
rules.why: Dart's guidance is to commit pubspec.lock for application packages, so every build uses the same dependency versions.

rules.message: Add analysis_options.yaml, including a lint set such as package:lints/recommended.yaml
rules.why: dart analyze, which hct lint runs, reads which lints to apply from analysis_options.yaml; without one it applies only the default checks.

ci.why: Tests that run only on someone's machine stop being run; CI runs them on every change.
